name: Do I need to be home during the eaves repair service?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be home during the eaves repair service?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you don't necessarily need to be home for the entirety of the eaves repair, it is generally beneficial for you to be present for the initial consultation and final walkthrough. During the consultation, you can point out specific concerns and discuss preferences. For the actual repair work, as long as our team has unimpeded access to the exterior of your home and any necessary utilities, your presence isn't strictly required. However, being available by phone can be useful for any questions that may arise. This offers a practical tradeoff between convenience for you and ensuring direct communication if unforeseen issues arise.
acceptedAnswer.description: You don't need to be home for the entire service, but it's beneficial for the initial consultation and final walkthrough. Ensure exterior access.
